model.budget_hint: cheapest capable tier for every sister-session action

body: Standing directive: the sister session runs DeepSeek v4.1 Flash with no thinking effort (DSv4FNone). It acts as a dumb terminal: it executes only directives issued by the brain, drains .fleet/inbox, spawns epic-focused subagents strictly per directive (never picking issues on its own), and writes acks/results to .fleet/outbox. The brain is the only issuer of directives.
